business_summary: Zhongfu Straits (Pingtan) Development Company Limited engages in the afforestation and forest management in China. It is also involved in processing and sale of forest products, such as medium- and high-density fiberboard; trade of agricultural products, including tobacco fertilizers, timber, pulp, and paper pulp; and seedling cultivation and tree planting, as well as the sale of seedling products. The company also manufactures engineered wood panels and decorative materials. The company was formerly known as Fujian Zhongfu Industries Co., Ltd and changed its name to Zhongfu Straits (Pingtan) Development Company Limited in May 2014. Zhongfu Straits (Pingtan) Development Company Limited was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Fuzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Zhongfu Straits (Pingtan) Development Company Limited는 중국의 조림 및 산림 관리에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 중밀도 및 고밀도 섬유판과 같은 임산물의 가공 및 판매에도 참여하고 있습니다. 담배 비료, 목재, 펄프, 종이 펄프를 포함한 농산물 무역; 모종재배, 나무심기, 모종제품 판매 등을 하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 공학 목재 패널과 장식 재료도 제조합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Fujian Zhongfu Industries Co., Ltd로 알려졌으며 2014년 5월에 Zhongfu Straits (Pingtan) Development Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Zhongfu Straits (Pingtan) Development Company Limited는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 푸저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
